name: Salesloft
description: Salesloft lets agents read people, accounts, cadences, calls, and deals in the Salesloft workspace of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Salesloft account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my deals have had no activity in two weeks?
Summarize my last call with the Acme account.
Which people in my cadences replied this week?

apps.name: Salesloft
apps.description: People, accounts, cadences, calls, and deals, over Salesloft's MCP server with browser sign-in.
